name: Mask of Night
body:
School illusion (shadow) [shadow]; Level antipaladin 2, bard 2, death mage 2, mesmerist 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, spiritualist 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The target is covered in a shadow that hides their full being. Their countenance is obscured, but their size remains identifiable. This does not provide them any protection from attacks, but they are not affected by light or sunlight if they are damaged by such or have weaknesses like sunlight powerlessness or light blindness. Additionally, they gain a resistance bonus on saving throws and deflection bonus to AC against spells or effects with the light descriptor or that are light-based equal to 1/2 your caster level.
